annotations.title: EV charging prices in Poland (UDT EIPA)

description: Ad hoc EV charging prices in Poland (for a driver without a contract) reported by operators to the UDT register EIPA: median price per kWh with point counts by power class (AC up to 22 kW, DC below 50 kW, DC 50-149 kW, from 150 kW), AC vs DC, cheapest and most expensive networks, share of points with a per-minute fee, recent price changes and the finwire index finwire_ev_charging_price_index. With network: that network's price list by power class and its price changes. Subscriptions and app tariffs can be cheaper and are not included.

network.description: Network slug, e.g. greenway, orlen, ionity, tesla; omit for the whole market.
